entries.note: Independent i18n audit of the nine keys this PR added to wire.remote_compute (run_limit, run_busy, refusal_conflict, repo_no_remote, repo_not_https_remote, repo_unpushed_commit, tier_cloud_run, tier_dedicated, option_spot), each value read in full against the en source and catalogues/en/wire.remote_compute.context.json, at head 217ccff46f5b in .worktrees/rc-client-core. DELTA PROOF (so this row does not claim the 43 carried values as freshly read): `git diff origin/main..217ccff46f5b` on en and on each of the seven locales adds exactly these 9 keys, 0 changed, 0 removed, and the previous passed row's source_sha256 d1d9119a235c1a8c09306f42438115f5211ede16addf80a8f88d6f78860367a8 equals origin/main's en bytes; those 43 values are the bytes that row already audited and are byte-identical here. MECHANICAL, 63 values: key parity 52/52 in every locale; {detail} is the only placeholder and appears exactly once in each value that has it; ICU parse clean; NFC; no Cc/Cf characters (no bidi controls, per the ur guide); no leading/trailing padding. Tier labels inside the context sidecar's 24-cell budget, measured with rich.cells.cell_len (cloud_run/dedicated/spot): fr 15/5/4, es 20/8/4, zh-CN 8/4/4, ru 15/10/4, hi 7/5/3, ur 8/5/5, vi 21/11/4. MEANING against the sidecar roles: run_limit reads as a concurrency ceiling and never as credit, billing or idempotency; run_busy reads correctly for a run or a workload; refusal_conflict names no idempotency key (the misreading this PR removes); the repo_* values state the fact first and put the remedy last; tier_cloud_run never says spot; tier_dedicated never mentions spot; option_spot reads as an opt-in capacity under Dedicated, not as a tier. TERMINOLOGY reuses the namespace's shipped renderings: run = exécution / ejecución / 运行 / запуск / रन / رن / lần chạy; remote compute = calcul distant / cómputo remoto / 远程计算 / удалённые вычисления / रिमोट कंप्यूट / ریموٹ کمپیوٹ / tính toán từ xa; commit/push stay English per glossary §2's kept-English set (fr/es/ru/vi) and Latin (zh-CN/hi/ur); Radient, origin, https:// and SSH are untouched in every locale. Register per guide: fr vous with U+202F before : ; es tú; zh-CN 请 on each refusal's next-step clause; ru вы; hi आप; ur آپ; vi drops bạn and uses plain verbs. 1 MINOR, corrected by this auditor in the audited bytes: hi-I1 option_spot was left as the Latin "Spot", while the hi guide sends every non-product, non-acronym loan to Devanagari (टोकन, कैश, फ़ाइल, नेटवर्क) and reserves Latin for product names, tool names and the acronym list; the same PR's ur value is the transliterated اسپاٹ, so one label had two policies. The audited value is now स्पॉट (3 cells). The other eight read clean: ब्रांच in repo_unpushed_commit is the living Hindi loan the guide asks for, so the older शाखा in bad_sha is the drift and is out of this PR's scope; commit and push stay Latin per glossary §2; क्रेडेंशियल, वर्कलोड, रिपॉज़िटरी and एजेंट are consistent with the shipped values; "क्लाउड रन" / "समर्पित" are the labels. Verdict: CLEAN-WITH-FINDINGS, 0 blocker/major open. Native-speaker review and rendered-frame certification are not claimed; the width figures are cell measurements, not terminal screenshots. Evidence: this receipt; the rendering check quoted on the PR.
